messages.subject: For Carmen Diaz | Sustainability, decarbonisation and global stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Holcim Media Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Carmen Diaz, Chief People and Sustainability Officer.

Holcim's global industrial footprint and decarbonisation agenda place sustainability, government relations, stakeholder confidence and disciplined execution at the center of long-term value creation. Those priorities align closely with the work I lead today across a major mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead institutional engagement, coordinate regulatory and stakeholder matters across operating and corporate functions, and translate external commitments into accountable owners, evidence, timelines and escalation. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of sustainability, government relations, stakeholder strategy and operator-side decarbonisation experience might support Holcim's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Holcim.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
